name: std::queue<T,Container>::push
intro:
Pushes the given element value to the end of the queue.

1) Equivalent to: c.push_back(value).

2) Equivalent to: c.push_back(std::move(value)).

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
value

 -

 the value of the element to push

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: Equal to the complexity of Container::push_back.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Insert 2 and 7, then remove the first element.

summary: Pushes the given element value to the end of the queue.
